question: Should doctor cleanup for this removed plugin stay limited to current shared stale-plugin surfaces, or should it also delete persisted install records and matching load paths?
rationale: Current main already repairs the warning surfaces through the shared helper, while deleting install/load-path state changes persisted config semantics and needs maintainer ownership before merge.

options.title: Narrow And Rebase
options.body: Move any remaining cleanup into the shared stale-plugin repair helper and leave persisted install/load-path records untouched unless a separate proof-backed follow-up is approved.

options.title: Accept Broader Pruning
options.body: Keep install/load-path deletion only after a maintainer accepts that upgrade behavior and the PR provides live `openclaw doctor --fix` proof on an upgraded config.

options.title: Pause As Mostly Covered
options.body: Leave this branch unmerged if current main's generic stale-plugin cleanup is sufficient for the original warning path.

recommendation.title: Narrow And Rebase
recommendation.body: Move any remaining cleanup into the shared stale-plugin repair helper and leave persisted install/load-path records untouched unless a separate proof-backed follow-up is approved.

likelyOwner.reason: She introduced the shared stale-plugin doctor repair path that now owns this cleanup surface.
